title: Finite scalar square of an existing projection-normalized Tate tower
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme, ell a prime invertible on T, and d a natural number. Suppose M is an AdicTower for datum ell, e_n identifies its levels with derivedRealization of finiteTwist, h identifies its tower with strictDerivedTower, and ProjectionNormalized T ell hT d M e h holds, using [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data] and [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For one fixed pair a<=b and every generator-normalized CoefficientLineComparison r of the ell^(b+1) and ell^(a+1) root lines, extension of e_b followed by scalarComparison and derivedRealization of proTwistMap d r equals M.normalization followed by e_a. No construction or existence of M,e,h,r is claimed.

lean.statement:
theorem tateTensor_normalizedSquare
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅ (derivedRealization T ell n).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d))
    (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d)
    (hp : ProjectionNormalized T ell hT d M e h)
    (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (r : CoefficientLineComparison
      (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
      (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e b).hom ≫
        (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (finiteTwist T ell b d) ≫
        (derivedRealization T ell a).map (proTwistMap d r) =
      (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e a).hom
